purpose: functional verification of machine published ports on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a published port carries a connection to the guest's port, and a file comes out whole
what is sent to a published port is what the guest's listener received
several connections at once each get the whole file
a published port whose guest port has no listener accepts and closes
what cannot be published is refused, and nothing is

detail.every port taken: every port from 31016 to 31018 is in use
detail.a port in use: port 31016 of this node is in use
detail.below the node's range: hostPort is 31016 to 31018 on this node, not 31015
detail.above the node's range: hostPort is 31016 to 31018 on this node, not 31019
detail.a low port: hostPort is 31016 to 31018 on this node, not 22

cases.name: a port taken back refuses connections, and can be published again
stopped, a connection is accepted and closed; started again, the port works as it was
after the node is restarted the port is still published and works
deleting the machine gives its ports back
